# npc-dialogue

Write what NPCs say with an LLM so they sound like themselves and like the game: persona files, a fresh random sample of 30 of the character's own lines in every prompt, scene facts (place, time, weather, what the player holds or drives, danger) and per-NPC conversation history, short spoken lines (usually 5-25 words, capped at 45) with at most one delivery tag, output cleaning (refusals dropped, prefixes stripped, slur rules) and speed settings (fast model, reasoning off, Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b in about 0.3 s).
